wine_name: Terroir Al Limit Les Tosses, Catalunya
wrong_facts: Hook says 350 meters elevation — ground truth says 600m elevation
Hook says 80-year-old vines — ground truth says 90-year-old
Vinification claims carbonic maceration for 21 days — ground truth says whole cluster native fermentation, two weeks on skins
Vinification claims aging in 5,000L neutral foudres — ground truth says recent vintages ferment and age in cement tanks (no wood aging)
Claims vines were planted before phylloxera hit Priorat — unverifiable and likely fabricated
Claims price of $45 — no price data provided
Claims Les Terrasses is $65 and Clos Erasmus Carinyena is $95 — fabricated prices
Claims Nashville hot chicken pairing works due to 14.5% ABV — ABV not in context data
Claims roots go 15 meters deep — fabricated specific number
Alpine orogeny 250 million years ago — the Alpine orogeny is Cenozoic (65 Ma to present), not 250 Ma
reasoning: The hook contains two provably wrong facts (350m vs 600m elevation, 80-year-old vs 90-year-old vines), triggering the hard cap of 1.5 on correctness. Beyond the hook, the output fabricates numerous specific numbers not in the context data: prices, ABV, vessel sizes, maceration duration, root depth, and geological dates. The vinification description is substantially wrong — it claims foudre aging when ground truth confirms cement tanks with no wood. The voice is reasonably direct and opinionated with no banned words, but the sheer volume of fabricated specifics undermines the entire piece's credibility. The writing style attempts Loam's directness but the fabrications make it unreliable.
